endorsements.quote: Documenting training progress is also key and must be performed systematically to ensure compliance with institutional and European standards [ 9 ].

A structured training plan should include basic education for all healthcare workers on clinical applications of AI, advanced modules for specialists who use AI systems in daily practice, and ongoing programs to stay updated on new technologies and regulations [ 8 ].
The legal, ethical, and governance dimensions of AI should also be part of the AI literacy program.

unlisted_practices: Update the AI policy checklist regularly to reflect regulatory developments and implementation feedback.
Collect ongoing staff feedback on AI system use and use it to improve procedures.

screen.reason: Editorial proposing a checklist-based methodology and framework for AI policy, governance, and compliance under the EU AI Act in healthcare.
